mechanism: Thiazide diuretics can reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of clonidine and increase risk of rebound hypertension if clonidine is withdrawn; both agents also cause sodium/fluid depletion potentiating hypotension and electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; ensure adequate sodium and fluid status; avoid abrupt clonidine discontinuation; consider alternative antihypertensive combinations if blood pressure control is suboptimal.
